answer_1.quote: With the success of foundation models, there has been an increasing demand for generating charts using Large Language Models (LLMs).
answer_1.outputs: Code for generating charts and natural language feedback for chart evaluation

answer_4.quote: We employ a double-blind 120 human study (of which 77 pass the rigorous sanity check) to compare pre-TTS (N := 1) and post-TTS (N := 4) preference scores.
answer_4.guideline: Participants expressed preference between pre-feedback and post-feedback outputs on a scale from -2 (strongly prefer pre) to 2 (strongly prefer post).
